verdict: AI chip sector shed ~$1T in market cap Oct 15-17 on AI-spending-durability fears; underlying hyperscaler capex (~$725B 2026) and HBM4 pricing remain constructive — mixed setup into Q3 earnings season.
body_md:
## Fresh Developments (last 24-72h)

**Signal 1 — DRAM/HBM Pricing:** No fresh official QoQ contract-price print for Oct 2026. Korea Economic Daily reportedly cited a 117% week-over-week HBM4 price spike in early October (unverified; source is secondary). TrendForce's most recent forecast pegs conventional DRAM contract price growth at +13–18% QoQ for Q3 2026, sharply decelerating from Q1's +93–98%. Samsung reportedly sought ~20% DRAM price increase for 3Q26. Memflation decelerating but still positive. **→ Bull fading at the margin.**

**Signal 2 — HBM4 Ramp / Correction Risk:** SK Hynix slid its HBM4 capacity ramp from Q2 to Q3 2026 due to sustained HBM3E demand (TechPowerUp). Micron reportedly adding 60K HBM wafers/month by year-end, targeting 100K (TrendForce, Sep 4). Samsung allocating ~50% of HBM capacity to HBM4. All sources agree meaningful supply relief is 2027. No new confirmation or denial of SK Hynix's original 'correction after 2026' signal. **→ Supply still tight 2026; watch 2027.**

**Signal 3 — Hyperscaler AI Capex:** Reports dated Oct 11, 2026 show big-four hyperscaler combined 2026 capex guidance approaching **$725B** — Amazon ~$220B (raised from $200B at Q2 Jul 30 call), Meta ~$125–145B (explicitly citing memory price inflation as a driver), Alphabet ~$180–205B, Microsoft ~$175–190B. No guide-DOWN observed. **→ Strongly bull; capex above baseline $600–700B range.**

**Signal 4 — AMD MI400/Helios + Custom ASICs:** No new October catalyst. AMD confirmed Helios "now in production" at Advancing AI event Jul 23, 2026. Anthropic/Meta deployments cited. AWS Trainium 3 (TSMC 3nm) now deployed for Claude training and Amazon Rufus. AWS re:Invent (Nov 30–Dec 4) expected to bring Trainium 4 preview. **→ No new signal this window.**

**Signal 5 — Optical/Photonics:** Coherent at ECOC 2026: CPO scale-out ramp starts **Q4 2026**; NPO and scale-up ramp in H2 2027; 6-inch InP platform targeting volume shipments Q4 2026. Lumentum fiscal Q4 2026 (ended Jun 27): revenue $1.01B, EPS $3.23 vs $2.97 est.; guided next quarter to $1.225–1.275B. Nvidia's first CPO Ethernet switch ships with Vera Rubin this fall. InP EML/CW laser demand exceeds supply ~30%. **→ Bull; CPO inflection approaching.**

**Signal 6 — Solar:** Section 232 proclamation (Aug 6, 2026) sets 15% tariff + minimum import prices on polysilicon derivatives effective Dec 4, 2026 ($0.38/W modules, $0.22/W cells). Yahoo Finance flags FSLR facing US inventory glut and slower utility-scale project starts as headwinds alongside the tariff. ENPH-specific commentary absent. **→ Mixed: policy floor is FSLR-positive long term, but near-term demand/inventory headwinds.**

**Signal 7 — Watchlist Movers:**

| Name | Move | Catalyst |
|------|------|----------|
| AMD | -5.7% (Oct 15) | Broad AI-spending-durability selloff; no co-specific news |
| MRVL | -8.7% | Same macro selloff; sharpest drop in group |
| AVGO | -4.5% | Same macro selloff |
| MU | -5.6% | Same macro selloff |
| NVDA | -1.4% | Same; Jensen Huang: "All of this is going to pass" |
| HIVE | No Oct data | Last print: Q1 FY2027 rev $79.1M (+73% YoY), GPU cloud ARR $180M contracted, $200M ARR target end-2026 |
| LITE | Flat | Approaching Nov 5 earnings; last print strong ($1.01B rev, beat+raise) |
| COHR | No Oct data | CPO roadmap update at ECOC — Q4 2026 ramp beginning |

*No NVIDIA/hyperscaler naming-a-partner catalyst hit watchlist names this window. The selloff was macro/sentiment, not fundamental.*

---

## Context vs Baseline

- Hyperscaler capex tracking **above** baseline $600–700B ($725B+ now guided). Bullish.
- HBM pricing still elevated, but the rate-of-change is decelerating — the baseline 'correction after 2026' risk is incrementally more credible as all three suppliers expand.
- AMD Helios in production is a concrete check vs the H2-2026 baseline expectation.
- CPO timeline on track with Coherent confirming Q4 2026 scale-out start.

---

## Signals Flashing

| Signal | Direction | Bias |
|--------|-----------|------|
| DRAM/HBM pricing | Still rising but decelerating QoQ | Bull fading |
| HBM4 supply correction risk | 2026 still tight; relief 2027 | Neutral / watch |
| Hyperscaler capex | Raised again; $725B vs $600-700B baseline | Bull |
| AMD/custom-ASIC share shift | In production; no Oct catalyst | Neutral |
| Optical/CPO | Q4 ramp confirmed; LITE beat+raise | Bull |
| Solar policy | Price floor set Dec 4; inventory headwinds | Mixed |
| Sentiment | $1T selloff on spending-durability fears | Bear near-term |

---

## Most Important Development

The Oct 15-17 AI-chip selloff (AMD -5.7%, MRVL -8.7%, AVGO -4.5%, MU -5.6%) on macro "AI spending durability" concerns is the dominant near-term event — but it occurred against a backdrop of hyperscaler capex guidance being *raised* to ~$725B. This divergence (market fears vs corporate commitments) is the key tension to watch heading into Q3 earnings season. If hyperscalers deliver in-line or above capex and guidance in their upcoming prints, the selloff looks overdone. A guide-down from any major hyperscaler would be a significant negative catalyst.
